title: Lead WhatsApp Cloud API Engineer
summary: Architect and scale mission-critical Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API workflows, webhook microservices, high-throughput message dispatchers, and CRM integrations for enterprise clients.
responsibilities: Design, implement, and maintain high-throughput webhook listener pipelines using Node.js, Next.js API routes, and Redis queue workers.
Build interactive WhatsApp conversational flows (quick replies, catalog messages, call-to-action buttons, multi-agent ticket assignment).
Ensure strict compliance with Meta Graph API rate limits, message template approval processes, and GDPR data minimization standards.
Integrate WhatsApp messaging engines with client relational databases (PostgreSQL, Supabase) and external ERPs.
Monitor webhook delivery health, retry policies, and automated incident failovers 24/7.
requirements: Demonstrated production experience with Meta WhatsApp Cloud API / Graph API v18+.
Strong proficiency in JavaScript/Node.js, asynchronous stream processing, and RESTful architectures.
Experience with webhook validation, HMAC-SHA256 signature verification, and idempotency keys.
Familiarity with Redis, PostgreSQL, or Supabase for distributed message queuing and state tracking.
Excellent technical communication and debugging skills.

responsibilities: Build high-performance web applications with Next.js App Router, React Server Components (RSC), and edge runtimes.
Craft bespoke UI components and responsive layouts adhering to strict accessibility (WCAG 2.1) and zero-bloat standards.
Engineer secure serverless endpoints, authentication mechanisms, and transactional notification pipelines (Resend API).
Conduct code reviews, mentor junior developers, and establish CI/CD automated test suites.
Optimize Core Web Vitals to achieve 95+ Google Lighthouse scores across all desktop and mobile targets.
requirements: Extensive production experience with Next.js (App Router), React 19, and modern JavaScript (ESM).
Proficiency in Tailwind CSS, responsive utility styling, and state management patterns.
Solid understanding of SSR, SSG, ISR, streaming, and edge caching mechanisms.
Hands-on experience with REST/GraphQL APIs, Zod runtime validation, and third-party SDK integrations.
Passion for clean code, semantic HTML, and intuitive developer documentation.

Experience with GitHub Actions CI/CD, Docker, and infrastructure-as-code principles.
Knowledge of network security, DDoS mitigation (Cloudflare), and rate-limiting strategies.
Familiarity with serverless database scaling (Supabase, Neon, AWS RDS).
